title: Fix strategy/candidate side selection for CLOSE_LIMIT trim candidates

scope.strategy_logic_change_scope: defensive CLOSE_LIMIT side mapping guard only

fix_summary.candidate_side_semantics: CLOSE_LIMIT side is treated as the position leg being closed, not buy/sell order direction.
fix_summary.guard_behavior: If a CLOSE_LIMIT candidate points to a side with zero contracts while the opposite side has contracts, strategy fails closed with CLOSE_SIDE_MAPPING_AMBIGUOUS_STOP.
fix_summary.executor_mapping_preserved: CLOSE+LONG remains CLOSE_LONG; CLOSE+SHORT remains CLOSE_SHORT.

SOL_after_fix.reason: auto: trim SHORT winner | leg_trim | leg-target
SOL_after_fix.note: Current live strategy snapshot sees SOL as hedged LONG=12 / SHORT=11. The long-only regression case is now guarded and tested.

summary: Added a defensive CLOSE_LIMIT side mapping guard in strategy_engine and regression coverage. Strategy now fails closed if a close candidate targets a side with no contracts while the opposite leg has exposure. Current SOL data is hedged LONG=12/SHORT=11, so CLOSE_SHORT maps correctly to closing the SHORT leg and remains live-disabled by policy.
